role: Execute one risk-approved crude-oil calendar-spread pair mandate over the next realized half-month using two real named futures legs, appointed execution-desk personnel, visible weekly liquidity and explicit per-leg trading costs.
invariants: only a v0.2.2 calendar-spread decision whose cutoff equals the execution start may be executed
execution start and end markets must be adjacent half-month cutoffs from the same deterministic world
the strategy book consumed at execution must exactly match the strategy-book identity frozen in the decision
the execution desk may reduce but never enlarge the strategy-approved discretionary pair request
existing residual-leg remediation is executed before any new pair exposure and is treated as mandatory risk reduction
mandatory residual remediation bypasses style completion penalties but never bypasses each leg hard turn limit
new pair fills are real named-contract fills and remain exactly balanced main versus adjacent next within each weekly execution window
no synthetic spread security or synthetic spread fill is created
weekly scheduling uses only newly realized weekly bars between the frozen decision cutoff and the adjacent end cutoff
execution personnel do not read bars beyond the end cutoff and do not write back to market liquidity or prices
spread, slippage and fee costs are computed independently for each real leg and summed for the pair
neutral score-50 TCA is computed on the same realized fills, not on hypothetical extra completion
temporary leg imbalance from new pair construction is zero in v0.1; only pre-existing residual remediation can be leg-specific
the execution report is a settlement input preview and does not mutate Strategy Book, Formal Account, cash, margin, interest or financing
portfolio internal order netting is outside this contract
